portholequest.configuration.title: Porthole Quest Settings
portholequest.configuration.journal.tool: Client journal appearance and defaults for a new world session.
portholequest.configuration.defaultListF: ACTIVE: unfinished executable quests or unclaimed rewards. COMPLETED: executable or completed quests. ALL: all visible quests. Valid session state takes priority over this default.
portholequest.configuration.defaultChapt: Default for chapters without a cached expansion state in this world session.
portholequest.configuration.blankDetailM: IMAGE: centered custom image. BOOK: FTB Quests book title and icon. EMPTY: no content.
portholequest.configuration.blankDetailB: BOOK mode only. Use #RRGGBB; default dark beige is #9A8765. The title uses the native font at 18px and follows Minecraft GUI Scale. Reopen the journal to apply.
portholequest.configuration.blankDetailI: Resource-pack texture location, for example portholequest:textures/gui/detail/blank_detail_logo.png. Used in IMAGE mode.
Display width in logical GUI pixels; follows Minecraft GUI Scale.
Display height in logical GUI pixels; follows Minecraft GUI Scale.
portholequest.configuration.blankDetailT: Actual PNG width in pixels. Set this to the source image size for correct texture sampling.
Actual PNG height in pixels. Set this to the source image size for correct texture sampling.
